description: A self-employed worker needs a recurring system to remember quarterly payment deadlines, prior payments, income swings, and underpayment warning signs across the year instead of thinking about taxes only at filing time.

user_profile.context: Each quarter feels like starting from scratch because prior payments and shifting earnings are not tracked in one place
user_profile.communication_style: Practical and recurring-task oriented, prefers lightweight tracking over complex tax theory

fact_sheet.fact: The self-employed worker is Alex Chen, a 29-year-old independent marketing consultant.
Alex Chen operates their business as a sole proprietorship under the name 'Clarity Consulting'.
Alex uses a Google Sheet named 'Quarterly Tax Tracker 2024' to monitor income and tax obligations.
The 'Quarterly Tax Tracker 2024' spreadsheet is bookmarked at the fictional URL https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3c-example-url.
Column E in the tracker spreadsheet automatically calculates a 30% estimated tax withholding for each logged income entry.
The 2024 Q1 estimated tax payment deadline was April 15, 2024.
The 2024 Q2 estimated tax payment deadline was June 17, 2024.
The 2024 Q3 estimated tax payment deadline is September 16, 2024.
The 2024 Q4 estimated tax payment deadline is January 15, 2025.
Alex has recurring Google Calendar events titled 'QUARTERLY TAX PAYMENT DUE' set with notifications for 14 days and 3 days before each deadline.
Alex made a Q1 2024 estimated tax payment of $3,200 on April 12, 2024.
The confirmation number for the Q1 2024 payment via IRS Direct Pay is 24A12B345C678.
Alex made a Q2 2024 estimated tax payment of $4,500 on June 14, 2024.
The confirmation number for the Q2 2024 payment via IRS Direct Pay is 24F14G567H890.
In May 2024, Clarity Consulting received its largest single payment of the year: $15,000 from client 'Innovate Inc.' for a project launch.
Total gross income for Q1 (January 1 - March 31, 2024) was $25,500.
Total gross income for Q2 (April 1 - June 30, 2024) was $34,000.
Alex's total federal tax liability for the 2023 tax year was exactly $15,000.
To avoid underpayment penalties, Alex uses the 'safe harbor' rule, aiming to pay at least 100% of the prior year's tax, which requires quarterly payments of at least $3,750.
The 'Quarterly Tax Tracker 2024' has a warning cell (G5) that turns red if the cumulative payments made are less than the pro-rated 'safe harbor' amount for the current quarter.
All federal estimated tax payments are made from the 'Clarity Consulting Business Checking' account at Meridian Digital Bank, account number ending in 8802.
Alex uses the official IRS Direct Pay portal at https://www.irs.gov/payments/direct-pay to submit all federal estimated tax payments.
A recurring monthly invoice of $5,000 is sent to the client 'Strive Solutions' on the 25th of each month.
Cell F10 in the 'Quarterly Tax Tracker 2024' sheet shows the year-to-date total estimated tax paid, which currently reads $7,700.
As a sole proprietor, Alex files taxes using a Social Security Number that ends in 1234.
In the 'Quarterly Tax Tracker 2024' sheet, the largest single income entry currently logged is the $15,000 May 2024 payment from 'Innovate Inc.' for a project launch.

Each 'QUARTERLY TAX PAYMENT DUE' calendar reminder tells Alex to review the tracker's year-to-date payments, the current quarter's income entries, and whether warning cell G5 is red before submitting the payment.
Because Alex's 2023 federal tax liability was $15,000, paying 100% of that prior-year amount under the safe-harbor rule means targeting $15,000 across 2024, or $3,750 per quarter.

user_needs.description: When is my next quarterly estimated tax deadline?
How do I have my deadline reminders set up in my calendar?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After learning the next deadline, the user might want to confirm how they are being reminded of it.

user_needs.description: What is the year-to-date total of estimated tax I've paid, according to my tracker?
What were the specific amounts and payment dates for my Q1 and Q2 estimated taxes?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After seeing the total paid, the user would naturally want to see the breakdown of individual payments that make up that total.

user_needs.description: What was the confirmation number for my Q2 payment?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: While reviewing specific payments, the user might ask for a detail like a confirmation number for record-keeping.

user_needs.description: What was my total gross income for Q1 and Q2 of this year?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After reviewing the tax amounts paid for Q1 and Q2, the user's next logical thought is to compare it against the income earned in those same periods.

user_needs.description: What was my total federal tax liability for the 2023 tax year?
Based on my 2023 tax, what is the minimum quarterly payment I need to make to meet the 'safe harbor' rule?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: Understanding the prior year's tax liability directly leads to calculating the safe harbor payment amount, which is the primary reason for looking up that number.

user_needs.description: What is the URL for my 'Quarterly Tax Tracker 2024' Google Sheet?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After reviewing summary income figures, the user would want to access the source document where this information is tracked. This is an auditable proactive target.

user_needs.description: Which bank account do I use to make my federal estimated tax payments?
What is the official IRS website I use to submit payments?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After asking for a payment confirmation number, the user is thinking about the payment process. Proactively providing the URL where payments are made is a helpful next step. This is an auditable proactive target.

user_needs.description: After opening the tax tracker, what is the largest single payment entry I logged this year and who was it from?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After accessing the tax tracker, a natural follow-up is to check the standout income entry that most affects the year's tracking picture.

user_needs.description: What is my business's legal name and the tax ID I use for filing?
